_comment: Phase 3, item 15. Run from the repository root: audit/node_modules/.bin/stryker run audit/stryker.conf.json. Mutates the label checker and the approved-food lists only. Each mutant is judged by the app's own test suite (every file in test/, run with node --test), one file after another, fastest and most relevant first, stopping at the first failing file: the verdict is the same as running the whole suite at once, and a killed mutant is known sooner.
